notes: Directed self-shots stop collapsing into regular selfies. Every selfie prompt carried a hard-coded 'front-camera selfie held at arm's length, face a little too close' style block — correct for ordinary selfies, and exactly the instruction that overrode POV, mirror, and from-above compositions back into a standard face selfie no matter what the director wrote. The arm's-length frame now applies only when the description doesn't specify its own camera; a description that stakes out a mirror, POV, or looking-down angle keeps it.
